body_lead: Karnataka Information Technology Minister Priyank Kharge said the state will launch a Rs 100 crore fund to identify India’s top 50 AI companies. Speaking at the Confederation of Indian Industry's two-day CII INNOVERGE 2025 event held under the theme “Make in India, Developed India & Digital India,” the minister highlighted Karnataka’s leadership as a global innovation powerhouse. "At the upcoming Bengaluru Tech Summit, we will unveil the Future Makers track to showcase 20,000 startups and launch a Rs 100 crore fund to identify India’s top 50 AI companies.
